Ltd.''' is an Indian media and entertainment company. It is a division of [[Reliance Group]], handling its media and entertainment business, across content and distribution platforms. The company was founded on 15 February 2005, as two entities, namely Reliance Big Entertainment and BIG Pictures. Four years later the two companies were merged into Reliance BIG Pictures in 2009, and the company's name was changed to Reliance Entertainment the following year.{{citation needed|date=May 2020}} The key content initiatives are across movies, music, sports, gaming, Internet & mobile portals, leading to direct opportunities in delivery across the emerging digital distribution platforms: digital cinema, IPTV, DTH and mobile TV.{{citation needed|date=July 2025}} == Subsidiaries == === Current === * Storyteller Holding Co., LLC{{Cite web |url=https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1297401/000119312516450671/d277745dex991.htm |title=EX-99.1 |website=sec.gov |access-date=27 November 2016}} ([[Amblin Partners]]) (investor, 20%) ** [[Amblin Entertainment]] – Family-Friendly Label ** [[DreamWorks Pictures]] – Mature Label ** [[Amblin Television]] – Television Division ** Storyteller Distribution Co. to provide Rs 4,000 cr for films] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090718175637/http://economictimes.indiatimes.com/Anil-Ambani-to-provide-Rs-4K-cr-to-Spielberg-for-films/articleshow/4781120.cms |date=18 July 2009 }} [[The Economic Times]]. * Big 92.7 FM launched a radio station in Singapore considering 8% of the population residing there is Indian.{{cite web |url=http://www.dnaindia.com/report.asp?newsid=1173264 |title=Anil Ambani Group launches radio station in Singapore DNA |work=Daily News and Analysis |date=24 June 2008 |access-date=24 January 2012}} * On 5 April 2010, Reliance acquired a 50% stake in [[Codemasters]].{{cite web |last=Hinkle |first=David |url=http://www.joystiq.com/2010/04/05/reliance-big-entertainment-acquires-50-stake-in-codemasters/ |title=Reliance Big Entertainment acquires 50% stake in Codemasters |publisher=Joystiq |date=5 April 2010 |access-date=2 August 2010 |archive-date=5 May 2010 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100505072712/http://www.joystiq.com/2010/04/05/reliance-big-entertainment-acquires-50-stake-in-codemasters |url-status=live }} * On 28 May 2010, the company achieved the first ever Hollywood box office market with the release of ''[[Kites (film)|Kites]]''. * Reliance co-produced director [[Steven Spielberg]]'s film '' [[War Horse (film)|War Horse]]'', which was released worldwide on Christmas Day in 2011. Many other projects from the director also have the company as a producer.{{cite web |url=http://www.financialexpress.com/news/reliance-spielberg-in-talks-over-2-bn-movie-venture/326882/ |title=Reliance, Spielberg in talks over $2 bn movie venture |work=The Financial Express |date=24 June 2008 |access-date=24 January 2012 |archive-date=25 February 2014 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140225182901/http://www.financialexpress.com/news/reliance-spielberg-in-talks-over-2-bn-movie-venture/326882 |url-status=live }} * In January 2012, it was announced that Reliance DreamWorks movies garnered 11 Oscar nominations.{{cite web |url=http://economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/news-by-industry/media/entertainment-/entertainment/reliance-dreamworks-movies-garner-11-oscar-nominations/articleshow/11619943.cms |title=Reliance Dreamworks movies garner 11 Oscar nominations |work=The Economic Times |date=1 January 1970 |access-date=24 January 2012 |archive-date=27 January 2012 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120127150744/http://economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/news-by-industry/media/entertainment-/entertainment/reliance-dreamworks-movies-garner-11-oscar-nominations/articleshow/11619943.cms |url-status=live }} * In November 2014, the company announced plans to begin the acquisition process of the North American and European mobile game studios of [[DreamWorks Studios]] in early 2015.[https://www.reuters.com/article/us-reliance-gaming-exclusive-idUSKCN0IY25120141115 Exclusive: India's Reliance Entertainment plans to acquire Western game studios in 2015]. Reliance Entertainment Pvt. Ltd. is an Indian media and entertainment company. It is a division of Reliance Group, handling its media and entertainment business, across content and distribution platforms. The company was founded on 15 February 2005, as two entities, namely Reliance Big Entertainment and BIG Pictures. Four years later the two companies were merged into Reliance BIG Pictures in 2009, and the company's name was changed to Reliance Entertainment the following year.
The key content initiatives are across movies, music, sports, gaming, Internet & mobile portals, leading to direct opportunities in delivery across the emerging digital distribution platforms: digital cinema, IPTV, DTH and mobile TV.
